scope: Generated AC1018 DXF serializer/parser control for the ordered root TABLE XRECORD values after reference projection. No physical-source replay, graph closure, or support qualification.
procedure: Use the exact ordered 13-entry profile produced by the bounded AC1018 raw/typed candidate and projection helpers.
Write a complete DXF through dxfRW in ASCII and Binary modes with mappings 0xbc→0x400, 0xbb→0x401, 0x501→0x901, 0x502→0x902, and 0x503→0x903.
Import each output with a fresh dxfRW instance and inspect the single XRECORD callback.
assertions: The record handle, owner and reactor read back as 0x400, 0x401 and 0x401.
The three ordered application values retain codes 360/361/360 and read back as 0x901/0x902/0x903.
All three ASCII profile markers and the ordered entry count survive typed readback in both encodings.
limitations: The generated targets are supplied mappings; this test does not prove they name emitted TABLECONTENT, TABLEGEOMETRY or DATATABLE nodes of the right type/owner.
No native producer drawing, whole-source conversion, output rollback/retry, ODA/AutoCAD acceptance, or semantic text/codepage proof is included.
Physical TABLE subtree export remains refused.
next: Connect target mappings to a complete output identity/role inventory and recursively closed emitted graph; only then stage the physical source XRECORD behind final capability revalidation, transaction rollback, CRC regeneration, and fresh readback.
